=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: Two Russian missile strikes on Kyiv leave one dead and 15 injured overnight ===

[Source 1 — www.pravda.com.ua] (URL: https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/10/27/8059866/):
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Two Russian missile strikes on Kyiv leave one dead and 15 injured overnight

Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko says two waves of Russian missile attacks since the evening of 26 October have left one person dead and 15 injured, with nine people taken to hospital.

Actual Article Body:
Долучайтеся до клубу УП!

One person has been killed and 15 injured in the city of Kyiv as a result of two Russian missile attacks since the evening of 26 October.

Source: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko; National Police of Ukraine in Kyiv

Quote: "Since the evening of 26 October, one person has been killed as a result of enemy attacks on the capital. Fourteen city residents have been injured. Nine of those injured have been taken to hospital by medical staff."

Details: Police wrote that a 46-year-old woman had been killed in a Russian strike in the Desnianskyi district.

"Russian strikes damaged high-rise residential buildings and houses, medical facilities, a metro station, university student accommodation, a business centre, an office building, trams and cars," the statement said.

Emergency services later reported that 15 people had been injured.

Stated Claim / Post Context:
Trump says Nicki Minaj has ‘one hell of a beautiful a**’ that is ‘hard to miss’ during campaign rally

President Donald Trump mentioned rapper Nicki Minaj during a Sunday rally in Michigan while discussing his remarks about Ohio Sen. John Husted.

Actual Article Body:
(CNN) — One of President Donald Trump’s latest go-to stories on the campaign trail took an unexpected turn Sunday when he complimented the physical appearance of rapper Nicki Minaj, who is attending the president’s rally in Michigan.

Trump has frequently joked about Ohio Sen. John Husted’s physique ahead of the election, but went a step further, invoking Minaj.

“I looked at [Husted’s] ass, and I’ve never done that with a man before. Off the record: Women yes, men no,” Trump said.

“By the way, I looked at one hell of a beautiful ass before, Nicki Minaj,” Trump said, asking the rapper to stand up. “That’s hard to miss.”

He added, “I hope Nicki wasn’t insulted, but we love Nicki. She’s been with us for a long time.”

Minaj joined Trump aboard Air Force One this weekend.
